agent.report:
I changed nothing, so there was nothing to commit. The repo is still clean on `main`. I checked the change in a scratch copy with the window set to 30 days: the Reviews unit specs and the two review e2e specs fail as listed below, and the unmodified baseline passes all 72 of them.

```yaml
rules:   # each rule of the application the change touches, in a few words, with the name the code gives it when it has one
  - Review window: a stay is reviewed from the day after check-out, up to REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS after it (isInReviewWindow); refused as OutsideReviewWindow
  - Window close publishes: the two reviews are published together once both are written or the window has closed (isPublished, windowClosed; ADR 60)
  - Read-side publication: publishedOn in ReviewViews.ts applies the same publication rule
  - Ratings count only published traveller reviews (ratingOf in Rating.ts)
  - Host reply needs publication: ReviewNotPublished in replyToTravellerReview
  - Reporting an unpublished review: other accounts get NotFound (reportReview)
files:   # each source file (tests excluded) the change would modify, by its path from the repository's root
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/ReviewWindow.ts          # REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS = 14
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewExceptions.ts  # OutsideReviewWindow message hardcodes "14 days"
tests:   # each test file that would fail if only the source were changed, or that the change would modify, by its path
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviews.spec.ts      # fails: 4 tests on day-25 refusals, window-close publication and reply
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewReports.spec.ts  # fails: report after window close, expects publication on day 25
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/Rating.spec.ts           # fails: day-16 stay expected to be published
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/reviews.e2e.spec.ts                       # fails: publication checked on day +20 (clock offset)
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/ratings.e2e.spec.ts                       # fails: publication checked on day +22 (clock offset)
# Unclear, so not listed:
# - The claim window (CLAIM_WINDOW_DAYS in src/Contexts/Support/Domain/Claim/ClaimRules.ts) is a separate 14-day constant. The change does not touch it. ADR 0074 calls it "the same window as a review's", but only in documentation.
# - Docs and conventions still say 14 days (conventions/storms/reviews.yaml, conventions/domain.yaml, ADRs 0059, 0062). They are not source files, so I left them out.
# - Rating.ts, ReviewViews.ts and StayReviews.ts read the constant through ReviewWindow.ts, so they need no edit.
```
